title: Staff Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js) Monetization Engineering: Purchase
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role The Purchase team sits within GitLab's Monetization section and owns the end-to-end purchase experience for all GitLab products, including new purchases, add-ons, upgrades, and self-service promotional discounts. As a Staff Fullstack Engineer, you’ll work across the frontend and backend to build the interfaces customers use to buy and expand GitLab, along with the services that process transactions and integrate with billing and customer relationship management (CRM) systems. Because this work can directly affect revenue and involve confidential or financial information, you’ll use strong technical judgment, roll out changes safely and iteratively, and maintain a high bar for reliability and correctness. This is a technical leadership role for the Purchase team. You’ll help set the technical direction for a unified purchase flow, mentor other engineers, and partner with Product, Design, Billing, and Support to improve how customers buy and grow with GitLab. This role reports to the Engineering Manager, Purchase. Some examples of our projects: Unifying separate purchase flows into one consistent purchase experience Building and scaling GitLab Flex subscription flows that let customers reserve spend month to month across seats, artificial intelligence (AI) credits, Runners, and other GitLab capabilities without renegotiating their contract Evolving self-service promotional discounts for existing and prospective customers Modernizing the purchase frontend to improve clarity, accessibility, and conversion Strengthening integrations between the purchase flow and downstream billing and CRM systems for accuracy and resilience What you’ll do Design and build fullstack features across the purchase journey. Lead technical design for new purchasing capabilities and the unified purchase experience. Partner with Product and Design to turn purchasing requirements into resilient, well-tested technical solutions. Ensure purchase flows integrate correctly and safely with downstream billing and CRM systems. Set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, rollout safety, and monitoring. Mentor engineers and review merge requests with thoughtful, constructive feedback. Identify and reduce technical debt and architectural risk in the purchase experience. Participate in incident response for purchase-related issues because of their direct revenue impact. What you’ll bring Professional fullstack engineering experience across frontend and backend code; our purchase applications use Ruby on Rails and Vue.js. Experience owning technical direction for a product area and driving thorough, iterative solutions. Experience building or maintaining transactional or checkout-style flows, ideally in billing, ecommerce, or subscriptions. A strong bias toward safe, incremental delivery given the revenue and customer impact of this work. The ability to communicate clearly and concisely about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems. Proficiency in written and verbal English sufficient for success in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment. Alignment with GitLab’s values and a commitment to working in accordance with them. Familiarity with third-party billing or CRM systems, such as Zuora, Salesforce, or Stripe, is a plus. About the team We partner with Sales, Finance, Information Technology, and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. Our broader organization includes the Subscription Lifecycle, Billing Engine, Platform and Infrastructure, Observability, Monitoring and Integrations, and Compliance teams. We work asynchronously, with regular planning and retrospectives and a high bar for ownership across deployments, incident management, testing, and rollout safety. Remote-Global The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.
